caption: Creamy beige tonkotsu broth with floating noodles and green onions, topped with dark green, textured nori seaweed, sits in a white ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern on a warm brown wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
